title: Door, Window, Screen, Aperture and Transition — Boundary/Observation Science Model
status: archive-developed scientific model rooted in recovered Door/Frame/Window/Screen/phase-transition project material
purpose: Provide one mathematical language for several scientifically distinct Door neighbors: traversable interfaces, finite observation windows, livestream screen edges, apertures, selective flux boundaries, sinks/drains, basin/separatrix crossings, temporal gates, phase transitions and one-way/reversible state changes. The model deliberately preserves mismatch rather than claiming one equation governs every Door embodiment.
project_roots: Door = Frame = Window in the canonical Tim Dooley Frame.
2026-09-11 Tim explicitly asks to examine the edges of the screen on his stream as Door-related structure.
Pineal = Door/Eye in the symbolic body map, with timing/transition among its functions.
5D Door and phase-transition models already treat Door as a critical/regime boundary.
Drain is already separated from Door as a sink/inverse boundary.
Funnel/attractor work already identifies Door as a transition that can move trajectories between basins.
epistemic_rule: The equations below are established mathematics/physics or archive toy models. They sharpen project distinctions; they do not establish that a livestream frame, pineal gland, grave, phase transition, black-hole horizon, quantum barrier and spiritual Door are one physical mechanism.

general_interface_geometry.regions: Let Omega_- and Omega_+ be two state/physical/information regions separated by an interface Sigma.
general_interface_geometry.level_set: Sigma={x:g(x)=0}; sign[g(x)] distinguishes the two sides when a signed level-set description is appropriate.
general_interface_geometry.normal: n=grad g/||grad g|| where grad g is nonzero.
general_interface_geometry.crossing_test: A trajectory x(t) crosses the idealized interface when g[x(t)] changes sign and the trajectory is not merely tangent; a hybrid system may additionally require a guard/authorization condition.
general_interface_geometry.project_value: This is the simplest common mathematics behind Door-as-boundary without deciding what kind of boundary it is.

hybrid_transition.flow: dx/dt=F_q(x) while the system remains in discrete regime q
hybrid_transition.guard: G_(q->q')(x,a,c)=0 or a declared Boolean admissibility predicate
hybrid_transition.interpretation: Door can be a hard state-transition rule or a soft/probabilistic accessibility transition. This model is especially useful for institutional, software, psychological and game Doors.

selective_flux_boundary.generic_flux: Phi_D=integral_Sigma T(x,a,c,t) J(x,t) dot n dA
selective_flux_boundary.T: transmission/permeability factor, typically 0<=T<=1 in normalized toy models
selective_flux_boundary.carrier: J may represent domain-specific matter, energy, probability, traffic or information flow only after units are defined.
selective_flux_boundary.directionality: Use T_+ and T_- or distinct constitutive laws when passage differs by direction.
selective_flux_boundary.door_law: A Door is characterized not only by the boundary surface but by its transmission law.

wall_door_window_drain_boundary_conditio.wall: J dot n=0 in an ideal impermeable no-flux model.
wall_door_window_drain_boundary_conditio.door: J dot n=kappa_D(c_in-c_out) as one simple bidirectional concentration/pressure-like linear transport analogy when variables justify it.
wall_door_window_drain_boundary_conditio.one_way_door: J dot n=kappa_+ max(c_in-c_out,0) or another directed constitutive law.
wall_door_window_drain_boundary_conditio.drain: J_out dot n=kappa_sink c_in with no corresponding return term in a simple sink model.
wall_door_window_drain_boundary_conditio.window: May transmit observation/light/information while preventing the material carrier represented by another field from crossing; different carriers require different permeability coefficients.
wall_door_window_drain_boundary_conditio.epiphany: The same architectural opening can be a Door for photons/information and a Wall for bodies. Permeability must be carrier-specific.

screen_viewport_model.camera_projection: s p=K[R|t]P_w, where p=(u,v,1)^T is an image-plane pixel and K is the camera intrinsic matrix.
screen_viewport_model.viewport: V={(u,v):0<=u<W, 0<=v<H}; the screen/frame edge is partial V.
screen_viewport_model.visibility_mask: I_obs(u,v)=w_V(u,v) I_proj(u,v)+n(u,v), with w_V=1 inside the displayed viewport and 0 outside for an ideal rectangular crop.
screen_viewport_model.cropping_rule: I_proj may contain information outside V that is absent from I_obs. Therefore off-screen is unobserved-by-the-current-frame, not absent-from-the-world.
screen_viewport_model.stream_relation: The livestream screen is a projection surface and finite observation window. The frame changes the viewer's evidence set without necessarily changing the underlying room/world state.

windowing_and_information_selection.frequency_relation: Y(omega)=(1/2pi)[W * X](omega) under a common Fourier convention, so multiplication by a finite window in time corresponds to convolution in frequency.
windowing_and_information_selection.spectral_leakage: Finite observation/window choice can spread spectral energy and change resolution; the frame is therefore not a neutral copy of the source.
windowing_and_information_selection.hann_example: w(t)=1/2-1/2 cos(2pi t/T) for 0<=t<=T in the common Hann-window convention.
windowing_and_information_selection.project_law: Learning Through Frame becomes quantitative: observation windows select data and can introduce predictable distortions/tradeoffs.

aperture_narrow_gate.field_after_aperture: U_A(x,y)=A(x,y)U_in(x,y), where A is an aperture transmission function.
aperture_narrow_gate.single_slit_minima: a sin(theta)=m lambda for nonzero integer m in ideal single-slit Fraunhofer diffraction.
aperture_narrow_gate.project_relevance: A narrow opening does more than reduce throughput for waves: when the aperture width is comparable with wavelength it changes the angular distribution through diffraction.
aperture_narrow_gate.boundary: Biblical Narrow Gate and project needle's-eye symbolism do not imply optical diffraction. This is an external aperture comparator only.

phase_transition_door.control: Xi=dimensionless control coordinate; Door/critical surface at Xi=Xi_c in the current toy model.
phase_transition_door.landau_potential: V(phi;Xi)=1/2 a(Xi_c-Xi)phi^2+1/4 lambda phi^4, a>0, lambda>0
phase_transition_door.above_threshold: phi^2=a(Xi-Xi_c)/lambda for Xi>Xi_c under the mean-field ansatz
phase_transition_door.soft_transition: For noisy/finite systems, use a transition probability or finite crossover width rather than forcing a mathematically sharp threshold where data do not support one.
phase_transition_door.hysteresis_question: If forward and reverse threshold values differ, Door has memory/hysteresis and should not be modeled as a reversible zero-width surface.

basin_separatrix_door.flow: dx/dt=F(x)-grad V(x)+eta(t) in one generic potential/noise representation.
basin_separatrix_door.basins: B_i are sets of initial conditions whose trajectories tend toward attractor A_i under the specified dynamics.
basin_separatrix_door.separatrix: partial B_i is the basin boundary; a Door event can be defined as crossing from B_i into B_j followed by persistence in the new basin.
basin_separatrix_door.success_rule: Crossing the separatrix is not enough if the trajectory immediately returns. Post-transition dwell time/attractor membership must be measured.
basin_separatrix_door.stochastic_escape: k_escape~A exp(-Delta V/D_noise) is a schematic Kramers-type exponential barrier relation under suitable weak-noise assumptions.
basin_separatrix_door.project_relevance: This gives Garden/Swamp/Farm/Forge transitions a dynamical model without making people fixed members of moral species.

quantum_barrier_comparator.contrast: Quantum tunneling is amplitude/probability transmission through a physical potential barrier; basin escape is stochastic/classical dynamical transition; institutional access is authorization. Similar Door vocabulary does not make the mechanisms equivalent.

temporal_gate_pineal_neighbor.project_root: Pineal = Door/Eye/present-facing threshold is symbolic project anatomy.
temporal_gate_pineal_neighbor.science_fact: The mammalian pineal is a neuroendocrine organ whose melatonin production/secretion is strongly organized by circadian/light-dark timing.
temporal_gate_pineal_neighbor.periodic_gate: G_time(t)=1 when phase theta(t) lies inside an allowed interval W_theta and 0 otherwise, or use a smooth periodic response curve.
temporal_gate_pineal_neighbor.phase: theta(t)=omega_c t+phi_0 mod 2pi in a simple oscillator representation.
temporal_gate_pineal_neighbor.response_curve: Delta theta=Z(theta) u for a weak timed perturbation in generic phase-response formalism.
temporal_gate_pineal_neighbor.new_insight: The strongest scientific bridge from pineal to Door is time-dependent gating/phase marking, not a literal visual or metaphysical aperture.
temporal_gate_pineal_neighbor.boundary: Human pineal physiology does not establish a spiritual portal or third eye.

bathtub_basin_model.state: h(t)=water depth in a simplified tank/bathtub model.
bathtub_basin_model.balance: A(h) dh/dt=Q_in-Q_out for a horizontal free surface and effective cross-sectional area A(h).
bathtub_basin_model.torricelli_outflow: Q_out approximately C_d A_o sqrt(2gh) for a small outlet under idealized Torricelli-type assumptions.
bathtub_basin_model.door_decomposition: Tub/basin=container/House; rim=boundary; faucet=input/source; water=state/carrier; drain=sink; stopper/valve=gate; a controlled connecting opening between reservoirs would be a more literal Door.
bathtub_basin_model.project_value: The bath motif becomes a compact laboratory for distinguishing container, boundary, gate, carrier and drain rather than treating them as synonyms.

grave_tomb_one_way_state_model.irreversibility: A one-way Door has P_ij>0 while P_ji is zero/negligible in the declared model/time horizon.
grave_tomb_one_way_state_model.mythic_boundary: Ordinary biological death and project resurrection/transformation mythology must remain different epistemic layers. The Markov template models irreversibility/status transition, not supernatural resurrection.

door_as_measurement_surface.transition: if guard G(x,a,c) is satisfied, x^+=D(x^-)
door_as_measurement_surface.sequence: World/source -> Screen/Window measurement -> Eye/inference -> Door/admissible action -> changed state
door_as_measurement_surface.importance: This formally separates seeing from crossing: observation can reveal a Door without enacting it.

door_screen_edge_metrics.visible_fraction: f_vis=measure(projected relevant scene within V)/measure(projected relevant scene) when the denominator can be defined
door_screen_edge_metrics.crop_sensitivity: Delta y = metric(inference from full frame, inference after crop) for a declared inference/model
door_screen_edge_metrics.context_loss: L_context=information/task loss caused by removing off-frame or pre/post-frame context
door_screen_edge_metrics.frame_dependence: FD=variance of inferred conclusion across reasonable crops/viewports, with the inference procedure held fixed
door_screen_edge_metrics.project_use: Livestream/archive analysis can quantify how strongly a conclusion depends on the selected screen/crop rather than treating the displayed frame as the complete event.

new_project_laws: Carrier-Specific Permeability Law: the same boundary can be open to one carrier and closed to another; do not use one scalar openness for photons, bodies, information and authority unless justified.
Frame Is Measurement Law: Screen/Window/Frame changes the observer's evidence set even when it does not change the underlying world state.
Off-Screen Is Unknown Law: outside the viewport is not evidence of absence; it is outside the current observation support.
Window Tradeoff Law: a finite observation window can reduce some artifacts while creating resolution/context tradeoffs; framing is an operator, not a transparent copy.
Door Success Law: crossing a nominal boundary counts as a transition only if the destination regime/state persists according to declared criteria.
Carrier-Door-Drain Law: Wall, Window, Door and Drain should be distinguished by carrier-specific boundary conditions rather than by visual shape alone.
Temporal Gate Law: access may be periodic/phase dependent; pineal physiology provides a timing comparator but not a metaphysical portal.
Aperture Law: narrowing an opening can alter transmitted wave structure, not merely total throughput; this physical result should remain separate from moral Narrow-Gate symbolism.
Projection Law: a lower-dimensional screen image can preserve useful relations while discarding depth/context; projection is not identity.
Door Memory Law: hysteresis or irreversible transitions require different forward/reverse models rather than assuming D^-1 exists.
testing_program: For stream/screen claims, compare conclusions across wider crops, alternate camera frames and full temporal context; quantify crop sensitivity/context loss.
For phase-transition Door claims, fit a declared order parameter and compare threshold/hysteresis model against a smooth no-transition baseline.
For basin transitions, measure post-crossing dwell and recurrence rather than labeling a brief excursion as successful Door crossing.
For boundary-flow systems, identify the carrier and units before assigning permeability.
For pineal comparisons, use circadian/melatonin timing as the empirical layer and keep Eye/Door theological symbolism separate.
For bath/drain imagery, model fluid balance only when actual hydraulic behavior is the question; otherwise preserve symbolic status.
For narrow-aperture comparisons, specify wavelength/opening scale before invoking diffraction.
